meta.name: work-with-pr
meta.description: Full PR lifecycle in a fresh task-owned git worktree: implement via the ulw-loop skill with mandatory evidence-bound manual QA → reviewer-readable English PR → verification loop (CI + Cubic, where Cubic is skipped only when its quota is exhausted) → merge by default → worktree cleanup. Decomposes one task into the smallest atomic, independently-mergeable PRs and builds the independent ones concurrently via one worktree per PR driven by parallel subagents or a team. Unbounded loop: any failing gate sends you back to fix-and-re-QA inside that PR's worktree. Use whenever implementation work needs to land as a PR. Triggers: 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'work on this and make a PR', 'implement issue', 'land this as a PR', 'split into atomic PRs', 'parallel PRs', 'work-with-pr', 'PR workflow', 'implement end to end', even when user just says 'implement X' if the context implies PR delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将实现任务自动拆分为可合并的PR并完成全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将开发任务拆成多个独立PR并自动走完提交流程
copy.tagline_en: Automate full PR lifecycle from task decomposition to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to split development tasks into independent PRs and automate the submission process

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把任务拆成多个最小的、可独立合并的 PR;每个 PR 在独立工作目录中开发,先做带证据的人工验证,再写英文 PR 说明;然后反复跑 CI 和 Cubic 审核直到通过;默认自动合并并清理工作目录。
howto.when: 当你说“创建一个 PR”“实现并提交 PR”“处理这个 issue”等,或上下文表明要以 PR 形式交付时触发。

say.text: 把这个任务拆成多个最小的、可独立合并的 PR,并并行开发。
say.note: Claude 会为每个 PR 建独立工作目录和分支。

say.text: 帮我实现这个功能,以 PR 形式交付,跑完 CI 和 Cubic 再合并。
say.note: 默认自动合并,除非你明确不让。

say.text: 提交前先做手动 QA,并把证据写到磁盘上。
say.note: 没有证据文件就不会提交推送。

howto.what_en: Claude splits a task into minimal independently-mergeable PRs, develops each in its own worktree with evidence-bound manual QA, writes an English PR description, loops CI + Cubic until green, then auto-merges and cleans up worktrees.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'implement issue', or similar, or when context implies delivery as a PR.

say_en.text: Split this task into the smallest independently-mergeable PRs and build them in parallel.
say_en.note: Claude creates a worktree and branch per PR.

say_en.text: Implement this and land it as a PR — run CI and Cubic before merging.
say_en.note: Auto-merge by default unless you tell it not to.

say_en.text: Do manual QA before committing and write the evidence to disk.
say_en.note: No evidence file means no commit or push.
